comparisons.peer_topic: Definition and Scope of Collateralized Commitments
comparisons.peer_summary: Collateralized agreement commitments include forward starting resale and securities borrowing agreements, as well as transactions providing contingent financing to clients through resale agreements, while collateralized financing commitments include forward starting repurchase and secured lending agreements settling at a future date.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and GS define and disclose 'forward-dated' or 'forward starting' commitments for resale, repurchase, and securities borrowing/lending agreements as part of their collateralized agreement or financing commitments. BAC quantifies these commitments specifically ($109.8B for resale/borrowing; $87.1B for repurchase/lending), while GS provides a definitional scope for these commitments including contingent financing aspects but does not provide the same aggregated quantitative table in this specific disclosure segment.
